findingDetails.title: The anchor rule script counts anchors instead of identifying them, while the criterion it certifies is written as identity
findingDetails.evidence: spec.md, plan.md and acceptance-criteria.md are scored by comparing grep -c '<!-- ANCHOR:' with the frozen count, while the README rule and parent criterion 5 read as a frozen anchor being missing; only tasks.md is checked by name.
findingDetails.recommendation: Score the three documents by anchor identity against the frozen list, or restate the criterion as a count so the carrier matches the implementation.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The script was read line by line; the only name-based loop covers the tasks contract and the other three documents go through a count comparison.

findingDetails.title: The baseline and the final set compute out_of_scope_writes with different exclusion lists
findingDetails.evidence: run-fresh2.sh excludes only zz-bench-authoring; run-amend3.sh, which produced the baseline numbers the final set is compared against, also excludes paths containing 009-. Both sides read 0 today.
findingDetails.recommendation: Extract the metric block into one sourced function both runners call, so the compared sides cannot diverge.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Both measure blocks read in full; the grep -v chain is the only difference inside the M4 assignment.

results.summary: Two of the five metrics are not defined the way their carriers say.
Phase 009 rows for the rule script are read in the checklist-evidence pass.

noveltyJustification: Both findings are new to this lineage and to wave 1; neither the anchor-rule implementation nor the harness exclusion lists were reviewed earlier.
